en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Hammad, from Al Halby, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:

‘Whichever man panics a man from the wall, or dislodges him from his animal, so he falls off and dies, so he is responsible for his wergild; and if he (the rider) breaks something, so he is responsible of the wergild of whatever has been broken from him’.
